question: What does SUFY's account registration actually ask for (email, phone, card, ID document or institution), and is any free compute credit granted at sign-up?
why: The developer docs say only 'Create an account'; the public site is a JavaScript shell and sufy.com/home is a login wall that the default read, every pinned provider, fetch and archive could not render, so the sign-up form was never observed. identity_cost.kind stays a placeholder 'email' with the detail unverified, and no sign-up was attempted.
